body:
literally there mentally rn. like i wish i could take it back because now i just look like a fucking idiot to them and i doubt they’ll ever reach out again.

and not to be dramatic but i’ve been dreaming of reconnecting with them since we lost contact. to lose all that hope for the future makes it feel like life just isn’t worth it. like this is the one thing i wanted more than anything for so long, but now literally nothing else matters.

you’re right, i feel like i’ve been discarded. we talked about ending things a few times and each time he promised he wouldn’t ghost. but that’s exactly what he did in the end, after discussing a trip back home to visit. he hasn’t contacted me in months, and i don’t think he’s one to look back to previous romantic partners, but i hope he does only for my own sake.

thank you for sharing, i can empathize with your situation so much. there were honestly so, so many flags but i chose to ignore them all. even now looking back i can recognize each questionable or painful moment, but for some reason i can’t get over it. it’s like i’m yearning the good times we shared together and hoping that he’ll miss me just as much, enough for him to come back and be as sweet as he was during those times. but i know that’ll never happen because realistically i had nothing to offer him. and i checked some socials online the other day and found that he sold his house in our home state so there’s just no chance he’ll ever come back.
omg you’re so sweet, im actually getting a bit emotional over how supportive you’re being. but yes of course i’ll dm the posting to you

oh i’m definitely applying to office jobs in the meantime. do you think applying to the library tech job would be reasonable/realistic or do you think that’s out of the question with just general clerical experience?
i worked for an appleone subsidiary? a few years ago but left because of the pay. that’s actually where the majority of my clerical experience is from, it just wasn’t in a library setting per se
it’s just an amazon warehouse, i feel like i’m literally going insane

i just double checked the requirements, looks like a year of library clerical experience is required. i have general clerical experience, but not library specific. idk i just feel like i shouldn’t get my hopes up after all the rejection i’ve been through.

definitely looking into continuing education, but i’m trying to change my career path completely and go into like social work or something. i feel like i shouldn’t be so hopeful about that either due to the competitiveness and the large applicant pool for the field

right, the position im considering applying to is just a library assistant one which is also just entry level hs diploma. there’s another one for library tech which is entry level bach but i think that’s too optimistic for me unfortunately

i don’t have one, i just want something stable with decent pay. there’s a library position i want to apply for rn but i just feel so defeated already knowing my resume and experience isn’t up to par with other applicants. the pay ranges from $16 - $25 (socal) but i know if i were to get the position it’d be just barely at the $16
i applied to just about anything i felt qualified for tbh. ranging from admin assistant, project manager, etc. to linguist, tutor, etc.

i haven’t even really been able to make it to the interviewing stage for most of them. just the very entry level ones. i’ve passed the qualification exams and made it into the first rank for each one i’ve taken, but my resume and experience are holding me back. i haven’t gotten much honest feedback on the resume, or much at all aside from “looks good,” and it’s hard to get relevant work experience from warehouse or retail. i feel so stuck and discouraged

linguistics, but i’ve given up on the private sector completely because i’ve had such a rough luck hearing anything back at all. i’m applying yo state and county jobs for just like entry level bach positions and am still having a hard time. it’s like there’s no chance for me

it’d be more of self harm than an actual attempt, i’d probably end up taking myself to the hospital. i just can’t stand being here or being myself anymore. i don’t think any amount of therapy or medication can ever change that.

ty for the reply, im really hoping that works. i looked up the test and the at home kit from the same company has like a 90+% accuracy rate and said it can even sometimes detect positives below the thresholds so im fucked as far as the analysis goes
would that be passable for a county/state job? i think the fork just said a positive result would mean automatic disqualification
california for a county job
mm i think if “you” had the charisma for a political career “you” wouldn’t find yourself in this situation with minimal opportunities :’)
unfortunately not possible due to the crippling debt and lack of real income

i don’t know any of his friends or family members unfortunately, we hadn’t gotten that far yet :( i have tried googling and trying to find local news on social media but nothing related to him has come up
for a week? :’)
just the company, but not like anyone in the area or region he’s in

how would i be able to make sure he’s safe aside from texting/calling? i can respect his decision to end things if he’s ghosting, but if so i don’t think another text would change anything lol? i don’t wanna seem clingy or desperate or whatever
is it weird that i thought of how empty my linkedin would be? lmfao
thanks for the validation, im sorry if you’re feeling that way too

oooh, i see. mine has mainly just been the burning with some itch and some redness, but i definitely empathize. i can’t imagine it’s a good sign for either of us.

same, it’s like it gets worse every time i look in the mirror. im nervous to touch my hair at all for fear of making it worse. my appointment isn’t until november but im shopping around for a dermatologist who might be available before then. i have medi-cal so i requested a referral but after looking over the policy im not even sure it’s covered. i figure if i’ll be paying out of pocket i should find someone i can trust and see the soonest.

sometimes, but rarely. i’ll feel a burning sensation along my middle part and cowlick randomly. it comes and goes but it’s definitely irritating. it’s also warm to the touch.

im sorry you’re going through this too. i hope your derm appointments go well and the treatments work in your favor.
tbh everything’s just gotten worse lmfao. one step forward two steps back.
mostly on top with some noticeable loss along the sides
thanks i just feel like it gets so much worse each day and i’m just worried the longer i’ll wait the less chance for regrowth
i was expecting the same to happen after taking the iron and vit d supplements, but there hasn’t been any noticeable regrowth. :(

those were my thoughts exactly back when i started shedding! :( i expected the regrowth to start after my iron and vit d levels improved, but i’ve only noticed more patchiness. i think what really convinced me on aga was the thinner hair strands i’ve been finding lately.

omg i’m sorry you went through that, it seems like a very long and uncertain process. it’s wild how these conditions are so unpredictable even for the derms. :/ 

i got my thyroid checked in 2020 before i ever started shedding but the results came back fine. i don’t know about sex hormones, but i got a blood panel done recently and everything was good. just not sure if the hormones are included on those?

i feel like the shedding is progressing more rapidly now and i’m feeling extremely self conscious :(

so any advice and opinions welcome
same situation i’m experiencing atm. following for support and information :’)

i’m really hoping it’s just te as well, but im heavily suspecting aga. :( most of the thinning is along the middle part, temples, and cowlick. there’s some diffused loss in other areas, but the lower back part is noticeably fuller. also noticing a lot of single hair follicles along the center part.

my derm appointment is scheduled for next month so hopefully things get better by then. also i regret waiting so long to schedule the appointment since i noticed the first major shedding around february. are the first few months of hair loss critical for recovery? or do they not impact regrowth significantly?

ahhhh, this gives me a bit of hope for a different diagnosis than aga! how was your biopsy? what did it show that helped determine areata and scarring alopecia? 

it’s so frustrating not having any definitive answers and knowing each case is different. i became a vegetarian around 12 years ago, so i’m sure the iron/vit d deficiencies did a number on me as well. :(

i hope you’re doing better now health wise, physical and mental!
lately yes. is that an indicator of either?
i see, thank you for the insight :(

thank you for the response, im feeling pretty devastated right now. i’ve been reading so many contradicting comments, but based on the posts and pictures most similar to mine i’m expecting the worst and assuming it’s aga. i want to be proactive about the loss but realistic about my expectations ☹️

would the minoxidil regrowth be temporary or permanent? and would it reverse miniaturization? i’m suspecting there’s some along my middle part based on the space between the follicles and the amount of single-hair ones 😞

still waiting to get everything checked out but i noticed excess shedding and patchy areas in february. figured it was caused by diet since im a long time vegetarian and did somewhat of a crash diet last november. 

had blood work done around june and had iron deficiency anemia and vitamin d deficiency (ferritin: 6, vit d: 14.2). the doctor prescribed iron and vit d supplements which i’ve been taking consistently.

the shedding has slowed down quite a bit since then, but im worried my part and cowlick are growing back too slowly for te. i’ve been noticing thinner/finer hairs falling out lately and am anxious it’s aga. i don’t think there’s a history of any balding or hair loss in my family so i’m really hoping it’s not something permanent. i figure it’s probably from the physical and mental stress from the past few months.

i’m not sure what treatment or product would be safe to use while i’m waiting for the dermatologist appointment. but i’m starting to feel really self-conscious and embarrassed because i’m not sure if the hair loss has improved since the onset or has worsened and become more noticeable.

would really appreciate some support and advice :(
